title: Rowdy's Wild Rides

BYOB friendly with coolers and ice provided
Epic swim stops with floats and Lilly Pads
Photo ID required (21+ if alcohol is onboard)

gap: Exact duration range for individual party rentals not stated
blurb: Guests book private boat charters with licensed captains on lakes around Nashville. Boats include pontoons for up to 16 guests and wake boats for up to 12 guests. The experience includes cruising, swimming, and enjoying music and floats on the water.
extraNote: Cancellations more than 21 days before trip get 100% refund · Cancellations 8-20 days prior get reschedule or gift card worth 100% purchase price · Cancellations within 7 days are non-refundable · No refunds for no-shows or no-call · Weather cancellations compensated with 100% value gift card · Tours halted with illegal drugs or alcohol by minors, no refunds · Common docks include Cook Public Use Area and Fate Sanders Marina; shuttle pick-up from residence, Airbnb, or hotel within 20 miles of downtown Nashville.

quotes.text: +0Such a cool experience! Chaz took us out on the water, and we just got to sit back and relax! We did a morning ride and got to pick the music, and sit out. Can’t wait to make this an annual event with my friends!
+0Marcus was amazing! He was so tentative with driving the boat and making sure we had the best time!! Would definitely recommend booking with them at any time!!
+1Chaze was very polite, helpful & had great customer service. We absolutely loved the jet skis. Affordable and we will do it again
+0Chaz was the best!!! We had a blast, book them book them !
